# kinsta_site (Data Source)

Looks up a WordPress site by ID, or by its name or display name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kinsta_site" "blog" {
  name = "blog" # site name or display name; or set id instead
}

output "blog_live_environment" {
  value = data.kinsta_site.blog.live_environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Site ID. Set this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Site name or display name (case-insensitive, exact). Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `company_id` (String) Company the site belongs to.
- `display_name` (String) Display name shown in MyKinsta.
- `environments` (Attributes List) The site's environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `live_environment_id` (String) ID of the live environment.
- `primary_domain` (String) Primary domain of the live environment.
- `status` (String) Site status, e.g. `live`.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Environment display name.
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `is_premium` (Boolean) Whether it is a premium environment.
- `name` (String) Environment name, e.g. `live` or `staging`.
